lines.speaker: riku
lines.text: Look at the garage floor, the oil trail leads exactly [beat] to the legendary Midnight Scooter hidden under that old tarp!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Everyone thought we lost it in the final crash, but the truth is [beat] much more terrifying than just a broken metal frame.

lines.speaker: rafiq
lines.text: I told you boys a thousand times to stay away from that corner, [beat] some things are better left buried in the dust and grease!

lines.speaker: riku
lines.text: Uncle Rafiq, you don't understand, this machine literally [beat] defied every law of physics when we jumped the school fence tonight!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: We used every scrap of high-tech gear we had, but the engine [beat] didn't start because of the micro-chips or the new wiring.

lines.speaker: dada
lines.text: Stop your shouting right now, you little fools, you really think [beat] your expensive gadgets were what made that scrap metal fly?

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Dada? You’ve been standing in the shadows watching us this whole time [beat] while we risked our lives for this legend?

lines.speaker: dada
lines.text: I built that scooter forty years ago using nothing but [beat] pure grit, heavy iron, and a stolen lawnmower motor from the neighbor.

lines.speaker: riku
lines.text: Wait, so the 'High-Tech Ghost' we saw in the security footage [beat] was actually just you wearing your old leather jacket and mask?

lines.speaker: dada
lines.text: I saw you kids struggling and decided to give the engine [beat] a little mechanical miracle to keep your crazy dream alive.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: So the legend of the Midnight Scooter isn't about the bike at all, [beat] it’s about the person who never let us fail.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The heavy garage door finally closes on the mystery, proving that [beat] the greatest legends are just family secrets in disguise.
